ABOUT.TITLE: About Me
ABOUT.DESCRIPTION: I'm Victor Alves. A tech enthusiast since childhood, I went from tinkering with computers to writing code. Today, I'm a developer with solid experience in Python, Angular, and .NET, and always eager to learn new technologies. In my free time, I enjoy working out, playing video games, and card games with friends.

PROBLEM-SOLVING.TITLE: Highlights
PROBLEM-SOLVING.SUBTITLE: Some of my most impactful deliveries

KML_UPLOAD.TITLE: Integration of coordinates files into the map
KML_UPLOAD.DESCRIPTION: I developed a feature to upload and read KML files in a legacy system, enabling visualization on an integrated map. Later, I adapted this feature for a newer system, ensuring code reuse and consistency.

TEAM_LEAD.TITLE: Leadership in RPA project
TEAM_LEAD.DESCRIPTION: I led a team of 3 developers to create RPA bots responsible for converting spreadsheet data into multiple proprietary file formats recognized by the client's system.

PIPELINES.TITLE: CI/CD deploy automation
PIPELINES.DESCRIPTION: I automated the deploy process using Azure DevOps, reducing manual failures and increasing the team's efficiency.

TEAM_GROWTH.TITLE: Training and Onboarding New Developers
TEAM_GROWTH.DESCRIPTION: I actively participated in the selection process and was responsible for training new developers joining the team, fostering integration and good practices from the beginning.

TEMP_TABLES.TITLE: Performance improvement with temporary tables
TEMP_TABLES.DESCRIPTION: I optimized a stored procedure used to generate reports. By using temporary tables, I reduced execution time by up to 70%, positively impacting the client's extraction routine.

CROSS_TEAM_HELP.TITLE: Cross-team support
CROSS_TEAM_HELP.DESCRIPTION: I supported another team to ensure the delivery of a system on time. Our collaborative effort led to meeting the timeline and satisfying the client.

RPA_RESILIENCE.TITLE: Made automation more stable
RPA_RESILIENCE.DESCRIPTION: I fixed intermittent failures in an RPA that fetched reports via iframe. I started fetching the PDF directly via authenticated requests to the server, making the automation reliable even with variations in the DOM.

CUSTOM_FEEDBACK.TITLE: Custom logo feedback system
CUSTOM_FEEDBACK.DESCRIPTION: As an intern, I created a post-consultation rating system with company logos instead of stars. I used SCSS to change the logo from black and white to color on hover, providing a unique visual experience.
